paragraphs: He is mentioned in Midrash Tehillim, at the beginning of chapter 103.[^1]

notes.text: The supplied text reads מד' תהלים רפק״ג, conventionally Midrash Tehillim, beginning of chapter 103 (ראש פרק ק״ג). The older note and candidate dropped the initial מ and proposed an unresolved work or 282; those are superseded by this contextual abbreviation reading. No named edition or modern numbering has been verified. The heading title remains R'.
